# Alan Pruitt — Curriculum Architect & AI Strategist
> Personal portfolio, research hub, and sovereign Curriculum-as-Code (CaC) repository of Alan Pruitt (Coach Alan).

## Core Identity & Architecture
- **Founder & Chief Curriculum Architect**: Webcognita LLC ([webcognita.com](https://www.webcognita.com)) & Exercise Science Adjunct Faculty at Arizona Western College (AWC — Hispanic-Serving Institution, Yuma, AZ / Imperial Valley, CA).
- **Core Methodology**: Curriculum-as-Code (CaC) governed by the **S-A-R Standard (Scalable / Auditable / Repeatable)** — treating instructional materials as deterministic software with a Markdown Single Source of Truth (SSoT), Git version control, automated CI/CD pre-commit/pre-push linters, Canvas GraphQL-first (`/api/graphql`) synchronization, and zero-trust FERPA PII auditing.
- **The Centaur Protocol & Clinical Reasoning**: Training students as **Clinical Architects & Problem Framers** (human judgment) and AI as the **Clinical Calculator** via **The Clinical Framing Protocol (`Pattern / Rule / Solve` • `Patrón / Regla / Solución`)**, **Simon Sinek's Golden Circle (`WHY → HOW → WHAT`)**, **Active Verification Telemetry**, and the **10-7-0 Mastery Grading Scale**.
- **Pedagogical & Civil Rights Governance**: Compliance-as-Code enforcing **ADA Title II**, **WCAG 2.2 AA** with a mandatory **9:1 Double-Contrast Guard**, **WCAG 3.0 Cognitive Accessibility** (*In Plain English* / authentic **Norteño-Spanish** bilingual parity), $0 ZTC Open Pedagogy, and federal/clinical Sources of Truth (**PAGA 2018 2nd Ed.**, **2025–2030 DGA "Real Food" Focus**, **ACSM 12th Ed. 2025**, and **NASM OPT Model**).
- **Sovereign Dual-Workstation Edge AI**: Air-gapped Apple Silicon orchestration pairing an **M1 Interactive Antigravity (AGY) IDE Cockpit** with an **M2 Unattended 7:00 AM MST Daemon & Local Ollama Engine** (`exw-argon4-cac:latest`, `exw-gemma4:latest`).
- **Rapid Prototyping**: Vibe Coding with strict upstream architectural boundaries and external edge simulators that bypass LMS HTML sanitizers.

## Production Applications (Lovable PWA Library)
- [EXW Digital Tool Kit (`exwtoolkit.com`)](https://exwtoolkit.com): 9-Box bilingual (`EN` / `ES`) Wellness & Physical Education clinical PWA aligned with PAGA 2018 (2nd Ed.), DGA 2025–2030, ACSM 12th Ed., and NASM OPT standards, featuring desert heat-stress telemetry and cryptographic student verification tokens (`EXW-[COURSE]-M[XX]-[HASH]`).
- [EXW Physical Activity Tool Kit (`paga2018.dev`)](https://paga2018.dev): $0 ZTC Student Open Educational Resource (OER) for Arizona Western College WPE/EXW courses built on the Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans (2018, 2nd Ed.) with `Pattern / Rule / Solve` clinical activity audits.
- [EXW-Demo — WPE Fleet Architecture & Curriculum-as-Code Hub (`exwdemo.dev`)](https://exwdemo.dev): Zero-login Progressive Web App mirror of AWC Course ID `42051` showcasing the Golden Circle (`WHY → HOW → WHAT`) Curriculum-as-Code fleet, WCAG 2.2 AA (`9:1` Double-Contrast Guard) pages, and 256 `10/10` Exemplar Solves.
- [Culinary Medicine Digital Tool Kit (`culinarycompass.dev`)](https://culinarycompass.dev): Culinary Medicine Digital Tool Kit (DTK) for the University of Arizona Nutritional Sciences & Wellness (NSW) Foods Lab, operationalizing the `Pattern / Rule / Solve` Clinical Framing Protocol and `###` case-audit delimiter protocols.
- [Flavor Architect (`flavorarchitect.dev`)](https://flavorarchitect.dev): R&D engine for the UArizona Wellness Foods Lab bridging molecular flavor compound synergies with DGA-aligned clinical nutrition to generate Imperial and Metric laboratory prototypes.
- [Arquitecto del Sabor (`arquitectodelsabor.dev`)](https://arquitectodelsabor.dev): Spanish-language molecular culinary R&D engine (*Motor de I+D — Laboratorio de Alimentos de Bienestar de The University of Arizona*) uniting flavor science with DGA-aligned clinical nutrition across Metric and Imperial prototypes.
- [Markdown to Documents (`mdtodocs.app`)](https://mdtodocs.app): Curriculum-as-Code document compiler that transforms plain-text Markdown into born-accessible, WCAG-compliant PDF, Word (`.docx`), and semantic HTML documents.
- [Prompt-per-Mile Offset Calculator (`prompt-mile-hero.lovable.app`)](https://prompt-mile-hero.lovable.app): Sustainability and active-transit telemetry utility that converts human movement and green transit miles into CO2 savings and equivalent AI compute prompt offsets.
- [AgFlow 5G — Smart Irrigation & Remote Operations Calculator (`agflow-roi-dash.lovable.app`)](https://agflow-roi-dash.lovable.app): Desert AgTech pilot utility modeling the operational, financial, and water-conservation ROI of 5G-enabled remote irrigation management.

## Authoritative Research Datasets, Architecture Briefs & Compendia (7 Publications)
- [Compendium 07 — Master Research Log: Curriculum as Code (CaC), Curriculum as a Service (CaaS) & Compliance as Code (Live Observatory)](https://alanpruitt.com/research-log/) | [PDF Compendium](https://alanpruitt.com/docs/CaC_and_CaaS_Master_Research_Log_2026_Compendium.pdf): Continuous 2026 longitudinal engineering dataset (`91` reverse-chronological technical analyses, `35+` ASCII dataflow pipelines, and `33` Instructional Design Role Evolution archetypes) tracking Google Workspace (Gemini 3.5, Gemini Notebook, Workspace Studio, Google Vids, Sheets Telemetry), Instructure Canvas LMS (GraphQL `/api/graphql`, New Quizzes January 2027 Mandate, 1EdTech LTI 1.3), and sovereign Compliance-as-Code verification (`DOM GraphRAG`, `W3C PROV-O`, `W3C SKOS`, `WCAG 2.2 AA 9:1`).
- [Brief 01 — Sovereign Clinical AI, DOM GraphRAG & W3C PROV-O Architecture Brief (S-A-R v2.2)](https://alanpruitt.com/docs/EXW_S_A_R_v2_2_DOM_GraphRAG_and_PROV_O_Architecture_Brief.pdf): Technical white paper detailing the 3,265-node DOM Knowledge Graph, local Apple Silicon Ollama inference (`exw-argon4-cac`), W3C PROV-O cryptographic provenance receipts, and WCAG 2.2 AA (9:1) accessibility architecture.
- [Manual 02 — EXW Course Fleet Laboratory Manual (v2.2)](https://alanpruitt.com/docs/EXW_Course_Fleet_Laboratory_Manual_v2_2.pdf): Applied field methods manual covering the 9-Box `exwtoolkit.com` Clinical Biometrics & Desert Heat-Stress Workbench, `Pattern / Rule / Solve` framing, and the Four-Part Submission Standard across EXW 101–265.
- [Portfolio 03 — AWC WPE Novel 100-Level Curriculum Proposal Portfolio](https://alanpruitt.com/docs/AWC_WPE_Novel_100_Level_Curriculum_Proposal_Portfolio.pdf): Complete ACRES & 16-Module Curriculum-as-Code proposals for 5 zero-prerequisite, $0 ZTC OER transfer courses (`EXW 110`, `EXW 120`, `EXW 130`, `EXW 140`, `EXW 160`).
- [Brief 04 — Project Horizon: 2026 AWC Innovation Fund Executive Grant Brief](https://alanpruitt.com/docs/AWC_2026_Innovation_Fund_Project_Horizon_Executive_Memo.pdf): Executive grant proposal (`$8,850` one-time request, `$0.00` recurring) and 100-Point Rubric Matrix establishing an air-gapped ADA Title II / WCAG 3.0 APCA testbed.
- [White Paper 05 — WCAG 3.0 APCA (100k+ Lux) & Norteño Screen-Reader Linting](https://alanpruitt.com/docs/Project_Horizon_WCAG3_APCA_and_Norteno_ScreenReader_White_Paper.pdf): Optical and linguistic R&D methodology benchmarking Bronze/Silver/Gold WCAG 3.0 APCA perceptual contrast under `100,000+ lux` Yuma desert sunlight and W3C SKOS Norteño-Spanish `.imscc` screen-reader phonetics.
- [Spec 06 — Air-Gapped Edge Testbed & Optical Telemetry Specs](https://alanpruitt.com/docs/Project_Horizon_Vendor-agnostic_Technical_Specs.pdf): Vendor-agnostic engineering specifications for the 16-Core / 64GB DDR5 / 16GB VRAM air-gapped workstation, dual factory-calibrated 27" 4K reference displays, and `100,000+ lux` photometer.

## Curriculum-as-Code Essay Series (Essays 1–38)
- [Essay 38: What If I Didn't Build the Graph? – Why Curriculum-as-Code Transcends Flat Docs-as-Code with DOM GraphRAG & W3C PROV-O](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-38-dom-graphrag-and-prov-o-curriculum-as-code/): Enriching 3,151 curriculum vectors with DOM GraphRAG, W3C PROV-O provenance receipts, Born-Accessible 9:1 XAI radar scorecards, and W3C SKOS Norteño-Spanish clinical ontologies.
- [Essay 37: WCAG 3.0 Cognitive Accessibility in Curriculum-as-Code](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-37-wcag-3-cognitive-accessibility/): Reducing student cognitive load through deterministic In Plain English and Norteño-Spanish scaffolding.
- [Essay 36: What If I Didn't Standardize the Loop?](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-36/): Why standardizing the clinical problem-framing protocol across an entire course fleet eliminates instructional entropy and student onboarding friction.
- [Essay 35: Automating Accessibility: Curriculum-as-Code & Continuous Integration](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-35-automating-accessibility/): Embedding deterministic WCAG 2.2 AA and 9:1 contrast gates directly into Git pre-commit and pre-push pipelines.
- [Essay 34: Prompt Per Mile: From GSU Demo Day to Vibe-Coding](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-34-prompt-per-mile/): Translating endurance coaching cadence and domain expertise into high-velocity agentic software engineering.
- [Essay 33: What Happens When You Stop Renting Your Curriculum](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/what-happens-when-you-stop-renting-your-curriculum/): Reclaiming faculty intellectual sovereignty from commercial textbook publishers via $0 ZTC Curriculum-as-Code and Open Pedagogy flywheels.
- [Essay 31: Beyond the Slide Deck: Architecture as Professional Development](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-31-beyond-the-slide-deck/): Moving institutional faculty development from static slide presentations to live, inspectable Curriculum-as-Code sandboxes.
- [Essay 30: The Logic Grid: Why Good Assessment Looks Like Sudoku](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-30-the-logic-grid/): How The Clinical Framing Protocol (`Pattern / Rule / Solve`) and localized physiological constraints make generic AI copy-pasting structurally impossible.
- [Essay 29: The Upstream Shift: Why Post-Production Accessibility Is a Failure of Architectural Design](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-29/): Why remediating broken LMS pages after publication fails at scale, and how born-accessible Markdown SSoT eliminates remediation backlog.
- [Essay 28: Beyond Performative Compliance: ADA Title II & Living Conformance Statements](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-28/): Replacing static VPAT PDFs with continuous, programmatic accessibility telemetry across live LMS course fleets.
- [Essay 27: ADA Title II and the Fleet-Wide Refactor](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-27/): A case study of the fleet-wide decorative-emoji stripping sweep, regex linters, and pre-commit hooks enforcing screen-reader clarity.
- [Essay 26: The POUR-Audit Framework in Curriculum-as-Code](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/26-curriculum-as-code-pour-audit-framework/): Operationalizing Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, and Robust (POUR) verification checks across heading hierarchies, alt-text, and legacy term deprecation.
- [Essay 25: Curriculum-as-Code as Sovereign Infrastructure](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-25/): Designing resilient, portable academic repositories that survive LMS vendor migrations and schema divergence.
- [Essay 24: Chatbots & Canvas LMS: A Cautionary Tale](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/24-chatbots-canvas-lms-cautionary-tale/): Why embedding commercial AI chatbots inside Canvas LMS introduces institutional FERPA/ADA risks, and how high-friction Socratic verification preserves human voice.
- [Essay 23: The Accessibility Checker Parity Illusion](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/23-the-accessibility-checker-parity-illusion/): Why Canvas LMS, Microsoft Office, and Adobe PDF accessibility checkers lack structural parity, and why Markdown SSoT is the deterministic path to WCAG 2.2 AA.
- [Essay 22: Foundational Human Movement in the Algorithmic Age](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/22-foundational-human-movement-in-the-algorithmic-age/): How EXW 101 deploys Curriculum-as-Code, the federal PAGA 2018 SSoT, and `Pattern / Rule / Solve` to build community health interventions in rural borderland regions.
- [Essay 21: Evidence-Based Nutrition vs. The Feed: Upstream SSoT Governance](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/21-evidence-based-nutrition-vs-feed/): How EXW 150 uses Curriculum-as-Code and the 2025–2030 Dietary Guidelines for Americans to insulate students from social media fad diets and unanchored AI nutrition advice.
- [Essay 20: Deterministic Clinical Guardrails: Preventing Hallucination Drift](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/20-deterministic-clinical-guardrails/): How EXW 265 deploys deterministic prompt guardrails, triple-hash delimiter encapsulation (`###`), and PAGA 2018 safety gates for special populations.
- [Essay 19: The Hybrid Ergometer Scaffold: Synchronizing AI Simulation with Lab Precision](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/19-hybrid-ergometer-scaffold/): How EXW 245 pairs cognitive pre-flight AI verification sandboxes with research-grade Lode Corival cycle ergometers under ACSM 12th Edition standards.
- [Essay 18: The Illusion of the Feed: Upstream SSoT & Feed Link Rot Governance](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/18-the-illusion-of-the-feed/): How unanchored dynamic LMS feeds introduce link decay and configuration drift, and how upstream SSoT governance resolves accessibility issues at the source.
- [Essay 17: Engineering Resilience: Resolving False-Positive Contrast Errors & Array Failures](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/17-resolving-array-parsing-script-failures/): How automated accessibility linters fail under visual WYSIWYG DOM pollution and how structured CaC eliminates array parsing failures.
- [Essay 16: Canvas LMS 3-Track Self-Guided AI Branch and Bilingual Scaffolding](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/16-canvas-lms-3-track-ai-branch/): Transforming static discussion boards into active Track A / Track B / Track C clinical case conferences across all 16 EXW modules.
- [Essay 15: Algorithmic Pedagogy & Continuous Integration: Zero-Regression Learning](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/essay-15/): Treating student learning outcomes and compliance rules as executable code monitored by CI/CD pipelines.
- [Essay 14: The Guided Learning Trifecta: AI Simulation, Application & Auditing](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/14-guided-learning-trifecta/): Deploying Google Guided Learning principles in CaC using structured P-T-C-F prompts and delimiter protocols.
- [Essay 13: The Vibe-Coding Paradigm: Speed & Full-Stack Execution in EdTech](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/13-vibe-coding-paradigm/): Translating raw domain expertise directly into production-grade web applications via AI orchestration.
- [Essay 12: The Clinical Framing Protocol Architecture: Pattern, Rule, and Solve in Coded Instruction](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/12-mission-loop-architecture/): Structuring deterministic health science problem-framing pipelines (`Pattern / Rule / Solve`, evolved into The Clinical Framing Protocol).
- [Essay 11: The Two-Part Scaffold Framework: Guided Simulation & Precision Testing](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/11-two-part-scaffold-framework/): Integrating AI simulation sandboxes with research-grade laboratory equipment (e.g., Lode Corival).
- [Essay 10: The AI Safety Auditor Pattern: Guardrailing In-LMS Student Simulations](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/10-ai-safety-auditor-pattern/): Deterministic verification protocols to prevent hallucination drift in academic environments.
- [Essay 09: Immutable Learning Analytics: Privacy-Preserving Student Verification](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/09-immutable-learning-analytics/): Auditing student engagement metrics within sovereign, FERPA-safe boundaries.
- [Essay 08: Bilingual Localization Pipelines in Higher Education](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/08-bilingual-localization-pipelines/): Automating English and authentic Norteño-Spanish curriculum parity without semantic drift.
- [Essay 07: Continuous Integration in Course Pedagogy](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/07-continuous-integration-pedagogy/): Automating curriculum deployment with GitHub Actions and Canvas API integrations.
- [Essay 06: Canvas AI Course Design & Modular Architecture](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/06-canvas-ai-course-design/): Designing high-touch student interaction tracks within learning management systems.
- [Essay 05: Instructional Engineering: Treating Pedagogy as Code](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/05-instructional-engineering/): Applying software engineering discipline to academic curriculum design and maintenance.
- [Essay 04: ADA Title II Compliance & WCAG 2.2 AA in Digital Classrooms](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/04-ada-title-ii-accessibility/): Enforcing sovereign accessibility standards and programmatic contrast auditing across LMS pages.
- [Essay 03: Air-Gapped Sovereign AI in Community Colleges](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/03-air-gapped-sovereign-ai/): Deploying local open-weight models for zero-cost, private student and faculty compute.
- [Essay 02: Curriculum-as-Code: Version Control for Education](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/02-curriculum-as-code/): Establishing Git as the Single Source of Truth for instructional design.
- [Essay 01: AI Assessment Design: Beyond the Multiple Choice Question](https://alanpruitt.com/essays/01-ai-assessment-design/): Designing authentic, interactive problem-framing evaluations that replace disposable multiple-choice banks.

## Turnkey $0 ZTC OER, NSF AI-Ready America 50-State Enabling Resource & K-16 Dual-Enrollment Datasets
- **Non-Competing 50-State Enabling Resource (`NSF TechAccess: AI-Ready America` & AWC Southwest Arizona AI Symposium)**: Alan Pruitt and Webcognita LLC **do not compete** against community colleges, universities, or state consortia for primary [NSF TechAccess: AI-Ready America](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/initiatives/ai-ready) grant awards. Instead, we serve as a proven technical readiness resource, open Curriculum-as-Code reference architecture, and subaward implementation partner supporting **Arizona Western College** (building on the regional momentum of the AWC-hosted **Southwest Arizona AI Symposium**) and **State & Territory AI-Ready Coordination Hubs across all 50 states**. Our S-A-R compiler absorbs shifting federal portal mandates (including human-in-the-loop safety governance for frontier AI and *superintelligence*) via single-source JSON-LD updates with zero drift.
